clauses.clause: 24 occupants + 0–5 L5 survivors (same ids, full health); routines sit/talk/treat/rest/share; nobody idle > 3 s; no gun on seated/lying people.
clauses.note: Both qualities load actual completed mortal L5 campaign saves, preserving24 station occupants plus5 low /4 high rescues with identical IDs and full health. All five non-guard routines are present; every-tick four-second census records zero idle ticks, matched routine clips and no gun on any sitting/resting person. All6 final frames personally inspected: carried people occupy the furnished shelter, not the old track rows; sit, rest, gesture and treatment poses are visible. Real L5 inputs and before/after state are retained; the before fixture failed routine and placement checks at both tiers.
